title: R--EPA R6 Warehouse Services
agency_path: ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY.ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY.REGION 9 CONTRACTING OFFICE
detail_text: THIS IS A SPECIAL NOTICE. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS AND NO CONTRACT WILL BE AWARDED FROM THIS NOTICE. The solicitation for this requirement (EPA Region 6 Warehouse Management, Maintenance and Support Services) has been solicited via GSA ebuy under RFQ1809510, as a Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set aside. This requirement will not be competed via fedconnect/ open market. Only GSA schedule holders who are SDVOSB's are eligible to compete for this requirement.
